div.head: Cn 1018 14.4
div.ab: elles oðre freolsa 7 fæstena. healde man georne. swa swa þa heoldon þa ðe betst heoldon.
Elles oðre freolsa and fæstena healde man georne, swa swa þa heoldon þa ðe betst heoldon.
Festivals and fasts shall otherwise be observed zealously, just as they were best observed in the past.
Otherwise, feasts and fasts are to be kept assiduously, just as they were kept when they were kept best.
